31011-the-tadpoles-of-bufo-cognatus-say.creator: Hobart M. Smith
31011-the-tadpoles-of-bufo-cognatus-say.description: A book by Hobart M. Smith. The indentations at the corners of the mouth in the papillary fringe are more prominent when the mouthparts are less extended. The outer row of teeth of the lower labium is sometimes a little shorter or longer than the figure shows, but the average is about as indicated.

arxiv-1712-07065.title: Joint model-based recognition and localization of overlapped acoustic events using a set of distributed small microphone arrays
arxiv-1712-07065.creator: Rupayan Chakraborty, Climent Nadeu
arxiv-1712-07065.description: Abstract In the analysis of acoustic scenes, often the occurring sounds have to be detected in time, recognized, and localized in space. Usually, each of these tasks is done separately. In this paper, a model-based approach to jointly carry them out for the case of multiple simultaneous sources is presented and tested.

arxiv-2101-08791.title: Combining cosmological and local bounds on bimetric theory
arxiv-2101-08791.creator: Jochen Weller
arxiv-2101-08791.description: Abstract Ghost-free bimetric theory describes two nonlinearly interacting spin-2 fields, one massive and one massless, thus extending general relativity. We confront bimetric theory with observations of Supernovae type 1a, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and the Cosmic Microwave Background in a statistical analysis, utilising the recently proposed physical parametrisation.

arxiv-2309-15140.title: A Review on AI Algorithms for Energy Management in E-Mobility Services
arxiv-2309-15140.creator: Sen Yan, Maqsood Hussain Shah, Ji Li, Noel O’Connor, Mingming Liu
arxiv-2309-15140.description: Abstract E-mobility, or electric mobility, has emerged as a pivotal solution to address pressing environmental and sustainability concerns in the transportation sector. The depletion of fossil fuels, escalating greenhouse gas emissions, and the imperative to combat climate change underscore the significance of transitioning to electric vehicles (EVs).

arxiv-2407-07829.title: Disentangled Representation Learning with the Gromov-Monge Gap
arxiv-2407-07829.creator: Theo Uscidda, Luca Eyring, Karsten Roth, Fabian Theis Zeynep Akata Marco Cuturi
arxiv-2407-07829.description: Abstract Learning disentangled representations from unlabelled data is a fundamental challenge in machine learning. Solving it may unlock other problems, such as generalization, interpretability, or fairness. Although remarkably challenging to solve in theory, disentanglement is often achieved in practice through prior matching. Furthermore, recent works have shown that prior matching approaches can be enhanced by leveraging geometrical considerations, e.g.

arxiv-2501-09477.title: From Complexification to Self-Similarity: New Aspects of Quantum Criticality
arxiv-2501-09477.creator: Yang Liu, Erhai Zhao, Haiyuan Zou
arxiv-2501-09477.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yang Liu, Erhai Zhao, Haiyuan Zou. Quantum phase transitions are a fascinating area of condensed matter physics. The extension through complexification not only broadens the scope of this field but also offers a new framework for understanding criticality and its statistical implications.

arxiv-2508-00619.title: DACTYL: Diverse Adversarial Corpus of Texts Yielded from Large language models
arxiv-2508-00619.creator: Shantanu Thorat, Andrew Caines
arxiv-2508-00619.description: Abstract AI-generated (AIG) texts are diffusing rapidly into our daily lives, blurring the lines between human and AI. Some use cases are malicious, such as generating misinformation on social media, producing fake reviews to mislead consumers, or writing false news articles. Thus, there emerges a need to build an AIG text detector.

arxiv-2508-12591.title: Beyond Modality Limitations: A Unified MLLM Approach to Automated Speaking Assessment with Effective Curriculum Learning
arxiv-2508-12591.creator: Yu-Hsuan Fang, Tien-Hong Lo, Yao-Ting Sung, Berlin Chen
arxiv-2508-12591.description: Abstract Traditional Automated Speaking Assessment (ASA) systems exhibit inherent modality limitations: text-based approaches lack acoustic information while audio-based methods miss semantic context. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM) offer unprecedented opportunities for comprehensive ASA by simultaneously processing audio and text within unified frameworks.

arxiv-2510-25671.title: An OPF-based Control Framework for Hybrid AC-MTDC Power Systems under Uncertainty
arxiv-2510-25671.creator: Hongjin Du, Rahul Rane, Weijie Xia, Pedro P. Vergara, Aleksandra Lekić
arxiv-2510-25671.description: Abstract The increasing integration of renewable energy, particularly offshore wind, introduces significant uncertainty into hybrid AC–HVDC systems due to forecast errors and power fluctuations. Conventional control strategies typically rely on fixed setpoints and neglect frequency deviations, which can compromise system stability under rapid renewable variations.

Updated evidence on causes of death is needed to accelerate progress. Methods We conducted a multi-st

europmc-pmc2814860.title: Pro-inflammatory cytokines, IFNgamma and TNFalpha, influence immune properties of human bone marrow and Wharton jelly mesenchymal stem cells differentially.
europmc-pmc2814860.creator: Prasanna SJ, Gopalakrishnan D, Shankar SR, Vasandan AB.
europmc-pmc2814860.description: Background Wharton's jelly derived stem cells (WJMSCs) are gaining attention as a possible clinical alternative to bone marrow derived mesenchymal stem cells (BMMSCs) owing to better accessibility, higher expansion potential and low immunogenicity. Usage of allogenic mesenchymal

pmc-11437770.title: The metabolic signature of blood lipids: a causal inference study using twins
pmc-11437770.creator: Yutong Wang, Shunkai Liu, Weihua Cao, Jun Lv, Canqing Yu, Tao Huang, Dianjianyi Sun, Chunxiao Liao, Yuanjie Pang, Zengchang Pang, Min Yu, Hua Wang, Xianping Wu, Yu Liu, Wenjing Gao, Liming Li
pmc-11437770.description: Dyslipidemia is one of the cardiometabolic risk factors that influences mortality globally. Unraveling the causality between blood lipids and metabolites and the complex networks connecting lipids, metabolites, and other cardiometabolic traits can help to more accurately reflect the body’s metabolic disorders and even cardiometabolic diseases.

pmc-11503950.title: Deep learning disconnectomes to accelerate and improve long-term predictions for post-stroke symptoms
pmc-11503950.creator: Anna Matsulevits, Pierrick Coupé, Huy-Dung Nguyen, Lia Talozzi, Chris Foulon, Parashkev Nachev, Maurizio Corbetta, Thomas Tourdias, Michel Thiebaut de Schotten
pmc-11503950.description: This study investigates the efficacy of deep-learning models in expediting the generation of disconnectomes for individualized prediction of neuropsychological outcomes one year after stroke. Utilising a 3D U-Net network, we trained a model on a dataset of N = 1333 synthetic lesions and corresponding disconnectomes, subsequently applying it to N = 1333 real stroke lesions.

pmc-12359567.title: Novel radiopharmaceuticals for molecular imaging of renal cell carcinoma
pmc-12359567.creator: Jasmin Weindler, Muhammad Ali, Cristian Udovicich, Michael S Hofman, Shankar Siva
pmc-12359567.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Conventional diagnostic strategies for imaging patients with renal cell carcinoma (RCC) have predominantly relied on ultrasonography, CT and MRI. However, a paradigm shift is underway with the emergence of several new radiotracers for molecular imaging. Carbonic anhydrase IX (CA-IX) imaging and sestamibi imaging can assist with identifying malignant renal tumours, whereas fluorodeoxyglucose, prostate-specific membrane antigen and CA-IX tracers can give guidance for diagnosis and staging of RCC.

pmc-12365300.title: What social stratifications in bias blind spot can tell us about implicit social bias in both LLMs and humans
pmc-12365300.creator: Sarah V. Bentley, David Evans, Claire K. Naughtin
pmc-12365300.description: Large language models (LLMs) are the engines behind generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications, the most well-known being chatbots. As conversational agents, they—much like the humans on whose data they are trained—exhibit social bias. The nature of social bias is that it unfairly represents one group over another.

pmc-12630851.title: Adaptive EEG preprocessing to mitigate electrode shift variability for robust motor imagery classification
pmc-12630851.creator: Wenjing Xiong, Lin Ma, Haifeng Li
pmc-12630851.description: Electrode placement variability poses a critical challenge in EEG-based motor imagery tasks, often resulting in reduced classification robustness. We present the Adaptive Channel Mixing Layer (ACML), a plug-and-play preprocessing module that dynamically adjusts input signal weights through a learnable transformation matrix based on inter-channel correlations.

pmc-12689327.title: Macrophage migration inhibitory factor–CD74 axis drives vascular smooth muscle cell–induced M1 macrophage polarization to exacerbate intracranial aneurysm inflammation
pmc-12689327.creator: Yao Chen, Jian-huang Huang, Qi-xiu Wang, Jian-hua Song, Jian-ning Chen
pmc-12689327.description: BackgroundIntracranial aneurysms (IAs) develop and progress through pathological processes, including inflammation and abnormal changes in the vascular structure. The cytokine Macrophage Migration Inhibitory Factor (MIF) is implicated in the pathology of vascular diseases. However, the role of MIF in IAs remains to be elucidated.MethodsTranscriptomic data from IA and normal arteries were analyzed to quantify MIF expression and immune infiltration (CIBERSORT).

pmc-13231808.title: Trends in acute specialist contacts following a primary care contact 2012–21—a registry-based study
pmc-13231808.creator: Målfrid A Nummedal, Andreas Asheim, Johan Håkon Bjørngaard, Kjartan Sarheim Anthun, Lars Petter Bjørnsen, Ellen Rabben Svedahl
pmc-13231808.description: BackgroundAcute patients in Norway can access specialist services through various pathways, with primary care services having a gatekeeping role. Although national data show declining acute specialist contacts, some emergency departments report increasing visits. This study examined national trends in acute specialist contacts following primary care visits.MethodsThis registry-based cohort study included all Norwegian citizens from 2012 to 2021.

pmc-13375388.title: Geographic Rounding on Young Adults With Childhood-Onset Chronic Conditions: A Mixed Methods Retrospective Observational Cohort Study
pmc-13375388.creator: Samantha H Collins, Alyssa Platt, Jesse Rhodes, Tyler White, Maragatha Kuchibhatla, Ruchi Doshi
pmc-13375388.description: BackgroundGeographic rounding has been associated with improved efficiency and quality of care on inpatient general medicine services. Young adults with childhood-onset chronic conditions (COCC) often experience longer lengths of stay and higher readmission rates than other general medicine populations. To evaluate whether geographic rounding could improve outcomes for this group, these patients were transitioned to a geographic team.

pmc-13402192.title: A triple-layer, autograft-free reconstruction strategy for skull base repair after standard endoscopic endonasal resection of pituitary adenomas
pmc-13402192.creator: Wenxuan Xin, Maosheng Xiang, Junjie Liu, Zijia Guo, Nan Bai, Junhao Zhu, Yuanming Geng, Weiyi Xie, Zixiang Cong, Chiyuan Ma
pmc-13402192.description: ObjectiveIt is imperative to prevent cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leakage following an endoscopic endonasal approach (EEA). This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of a simple, triple-layer reconstruction strategy for preventing CSF rhinorrhea following the standard EEA for pituitary adenomas.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 213 patients who underwent a standard EEA for primary pituitary adenomas between January 2023 and March 2025.
